_comment: Frozen step-4 block-caller defaults. Blind: every value here was chosen
from the within-family permutation decoys, never from any curated RNA set.
Changing a value means re-running the decoy null, because the score floors
are empirical properties of that null and not transferable constants.
_floor_derivation: RE-DERIVED from the corrected run (job 26739540: dedup-sequence clade
identity, stratified window cap, quota-constrained decoys; 75 clades,
225 decoy clades). The two floors happen to land on the same values as
the earlier invalidated run, but they are re-derived, not carried over.
Corrected decoy composite-score distribution, n=45 decoy blocks:
0.80 sits 0.08 above the highest decoy block in the entire run, so the
floor is above the whole observed null rather than at a chosen quantile
of it. Caveat recorded deliberately: only Cas3 (28) and GroupII_RT (17)
produced any decoy blocks at all, so the floor is measured on those two
families' nulls; IS110, RT and TnpB_Cas12f contributed zero decoy blocks
and therefore constrain the floor only from above.

_rationale.reference_picker: Taking the longest windows gave three near-identical references and left diverged clade members with no hit at all, which is silent: they simply never contribute to recurrence. Spreading references across anchor-protein 5-mer diversity raised clade coverage from 29/43 to 38/43.
_rationale.k_references: Measured, not assumed. Past 3 the clade coverage falls (38 -> 37 -> 32 -> 30 at k=3,4,6,8) while the decoy rate climbs, because a reference set spanning the family's diversity also gives unrelated decoy members something to align to.
_rationale.min_recurrence: At 0.5 the real:decoy block ratio is ~6:1 and 29/43 real clades carry a block against 8/129 decoy clades. At 0.3 the decoy clade rate triples. [Measured on the earlier clade set; the corrected run gives 66/75 real vs 25/225 decoy clades with a block at this setting.]
_rationale.score_floor: Zero decoy blocks at or above 0.80 in every family on the corrected null; the highest decoy block in the run scores 0.7194. Empirical FDR 0.0 in all five families. See _floor_derivation.
_rationale.high_confidence_floor: Zero decoy blocks at or above 0.90 in every family, with the same 0.7194 ceiling on the null. 68 of 263 real blocks clear it.

_benchmark_only_note: Retained, with the reason restated rather than carried over. The old justification (decoys cleared the floor at FDR 0.556) is withdrawn: that null was degenerate, and on the corrected run Cas3 has 6 clades, a strong null, and 0 decoy blocks at or above 0.80, so Cas3 passes the FDR test. The flag stays for two reasons that survive the correction: Cas3 supplies the highest-scoring decoy blocks in the entire run (max 0.7194, against GroupII_RT's 0.5648), so it has the narrowest real-vs-decoy margin of any family; and PF18019 is a promiscuous HD domain, which is an independent reason its 'clade' may not be a coherent evolutionary unit. Lifting the flag is a deliberate decision to be made on evidence, not a default.
